corrected_fields.summary: SunOpta Inc., a food/beverage company dual-listed on Nasdaq (STKL) and TSX (SOY), filed a Form 8-K reporting shareholder voting results from a special meeting held April 16, 2026. Shareholders approved a statutory arrangement under which Pegasus BidCo B.V., through subsidiary 2786694 Alberta Ltd., will acquire all outstanding common shares. The Arrangement Resolution passed with 95,088,870 votes for, 1,728,826 against, and 151,336 abstentions, representing approximately 80% voter turnout.
